scope: read-only source audit plus injected/local-temporary resolver probes; no external network, private path, USL source, or persistent USL record was touched
confirmed_behavior: ResolversLive normalizes both configured and per-request allowlists before their intersection, so a request cannot broaden configured permission.
The URL resolver uses manual redirects and checks each target before the next fetch.
Filesystem resolution checks the requested locator first and its realpath before stat/read; an authorized symlink target needs a separate canonical locator entry.
observeProgram restricts targets to selected link participants and selected meaning groundings, applies maxResources before resolver calls, and reports selected read scope and resolver call count.
CLI observe passes selected links, explicit allowlist or deny-all, and max-resources into observeProgram; record mutations remain limited to explicit pierce/audit --write/rebind paths.

real_findings.evidence: resolveFs realpaths and authorizes a pathname, then performs stat and readFile by that pathname (src/resolve.ts:72-90). A concurrent local actor can replace the object after realpath/authorization and before readFile, so the content hash can describe a different object than the authorized realpath.
real_findings.effect: The exact-locator/symlink policy is enforced for a stable filesystem but is not an adversarial TOCTOU boundary.
real_findings.separation: Every filesystem result is explicitly guaranteeLevel=trust_host. That makes hostile-host protection outside the stated guarantee; the ordering remains relevant if documentation describes the allowlist as a race-safe enforcement boundary.

documented_or_intentional_limits: URL, filesystem, Git, and KG resolvers return trust_host in the reviewed implementation; resolution is not sandboxed attestation.
Semantic truth and declared contract checks remain NOT_EVALUATED/NOT_EXECUTED in the v2 observation report; resolution does not prove meaning.
storage.ts documents compare-and-swap as cooperative concurrent-writer protection, not a hostile-filesystem transaction protocol.
The v2 report is selected-link scoped. It intentionally omits unused resources and meanings rather than claiming global plan resolution.
integration_note: Current USL runtime emits usl-program-observation/v2 with plan/meaning/source digests, readScope, metrics, and selected-only records (src/language/runtime.ts:85-93). An adapter limited to the earlier exact v1 report shape is not compatible until it explicitly validates this v2 contract.
